general.internal.description: Error shown when something went wrong on Homeroom's side and the person's action did not happen. Say plainly that it is Homeroom's fault, not theirs.

general.internalStop.description: Error shown when something went wrong on Homeroom's side and the person's action did not happen. Keeps its closing full stop.

general.invalidData.description: Error shown when what the person entered or sent was refused because some of it was not acceptable.

general.notFound.description: Error shown when the thing the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

general.tooLarge.description: Error shown when what the person tried to send or upload is bigger than Homeroom accepts.

general.uploadFailed.description: Error shown when a file the person chose could not be uploaded.

project.notFound.description: Error shown when the app or project the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.proposalNotFound.description: Error shown when the proposed change the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.issueNotFound.description: Error shown when the request (an issue on a project) the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.sessionNotFound.description: Error shown when the working session the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.agentSessionNotFound.description: Error shown when the AI agent's working session the person opened or acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

project.eventNotFound.description: Error shown when the season event the person opened does not exist or is no longer there. Keeps its closing full stop.

chat.messageNotFound.description: Error shown when the chat message the person acted on does not exist or was deleted.

chat.threadNotFound.description: Error shown when the chat thread the person opened does not exist or is no longer there.

chat.notificationNotFound.description: Error shown when the notification the person acted on does not exist or is no longer there.

account.userNotFound.description: Error shown when the person's account or the account they looked for does not exist.

account.userNotFoundStop.description: Error shown when the person's account or the account they looked for does not exist. Keeps its closing full stop.

account.notFound.description: Error shown during sign-in when no account matches what the person gave.

signIn.notAuthenticated.description: Error shown when an action needs the person to be signed in and they are not.

signIn.notSignedIn.description: Error shown when an action needs the person to be signed in and they are not. Keeps its closing full stop.

signIn.signInFirst.description: Error shown when a person who is not signed in tries something that needs an account: asks them to sign in.

signIn.signOutFirst.text: Sign out before signing in again.
signIn.signOutFirst.description: Error shown when a person already signed in starts another sign-in: asks them to sign out first.

signIn.invalidCredentials.description: Error shown on the sign-in screen when the username or email and password do not match.

signIn.usernamePasswordRequired.description: Error shown on the sign-in screen when the username or the password was left empty.

signIn.emailRequired.description: Error shown on the sign-in or password reset screen when the email address was left empty.

signIn.tooLong.text: That sign-in took too long, or started somewhere else. Try again.
signIn.tooLong.description: Error shown when a sign-in with an outside provider expired or was begun on another device or browser.

signIn.notSetUp.text: That sign-in is not set up.
signIn.notSetUp.description: Error shown when the person chose an outside sign-in provider that this Homeroom has not been configured for.

signIn.signatureFailed.description: Error shown when signing in with a crypto wallet: the wallet's signature could not be confirmed.

signUp.usernameTaken.description: Error shown when creating an account or changing a username: somebody else already has that username.

signUp.usernameTakenStop.description: Error shown when creating an account or changing a username: somebody else already has that username.

signUp.sessionExpired.text: Your signup session expired. Request a new code.
signUp.sessionExpired.description: Error shown while creating an account when too much time has passed since the emailed or texted code: asks the person to request another code.

signUp.activationCode.text: Invalid or already used activation code
signUp.activationCode.description: Error shown when the activation code the person entered is wrong or has been used.

signUp.tooManyFromAddress.text: Too many signups from this address. Try again in a few minutes.
signUp.tooManyFromAddress.description: Error shown when too many accounts were started from one internet connection: asks the person to wait a few minutes.

signUp.tooManyUsernames.text: Too many username attempts. Try again in a little while.
signUp.tooManyUsernames.description: Error shown when the person tried too many usernames in a row: asks them to wait a little.

access.notLetInYet.text: Your account does not have platform access yet.
access.notLetInYet.description: Error shown to a person still on the waitlist when they try something only let-in people can do.

password.resetLinkInvalid.description: Error shown when the emailed password reset link is wrong or too old: the person needs a new link.

password.currentRequired.description: Error shown on the change password form when the current password was left empty.

password.currentIncorrect.description: Error shown on the change password form when the current password entered is wrong.

password.noMatch.description: Error shown when the two new password fields differ.

password.mustDiffer.text: New password must be different from your current password
password.mustDiffer.description: Error shown on the change password form when the new password is the same as the old one.
